subject: MOP sync — weekend MOP window and retrograde rollback plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ops-team@acmehealth.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: MOP sync — weekend MOP window and retrograde rollback plan

Team — putting the weekend maintenance window and a proposed "retrograde rollback" sequence on your radar. This is for the Private deployment for AcmeHealth (v1.8.4 -> 1.9.0 patch). Key asks below, please reply with confirmations or blockers by EOD today so we can finalize the change request.

Summary / ask:
- Proposed window: Sat 2027-06-05 02:00-05:00 PT (3-hour hard window; 2h expected work + 1h buffer).
- MOP attached: mop_sync_v2.xlsx (sheet: timeline, validation, contacts).
- Goal: staged rollout across three racks (canary -> batch -> fleet) with a retrograde rollback ordering if we need to undo (fleet -> batch -> canary) to minimize KV cache divergence.
- Required confirmations: KV cache drain steps, model pin/unpin gating, NetOps BGP quiesce plan, and who will execute off-ramps.

Rollback acceptance criteria (high level):
1) Elevated 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5 minutes across region AND inability for canary to remediate after 2 attempts.
2) Visible rise in tail latency (p95) > 200ms above baseline persisting > 10 minutes.
3) Any data-plane certificate/key issue that affects more than one rack.

Retrograde rollback sequence (proposal):
- Immediate action: fail traffic to next-best model variant (within same pinned family) and close ingress.
- Step 1: Evict fleet slice (most recent), restore binaries/config to 1.8.4, restart with warmed KV backing (drain/replicate TTL).
- Step 2: Repeat for batch slice.
- Step 3: Revert canary, re-enable traffic, run smoke validations.

Please use the runbook link (related_links) and flag any missing runbook items. I'm assigning primary incident lead to Neha and NetOps coordination to Laura unless objections.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ops-team@acmehealth.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MOP sync — weekend MOP window and retrograde rollback plan

Jonas — thanks for the draft. I read the MOP and added a short checklist on the timeline tab. A few quick notes / confirmations from ops: 

- KV cache: we'll perform a staged drain on canary 30m before cutover (graceful KV flush + snapshot). After canary passes smoke we will copy active KV snapshot to batch nodes (s3 presigned). If we abort, we will restore pre-change snapshot — ensure snapshot naming convention in MOP.
- Model pin/unpin: we require a pinned manifest in S3 and an explicit "unpin approval" step in the MOP. Without that approval, orchestrator will not unpin.
- Network: Laura / NetOps please confirm BGP quiesce steps; I'm proposing a soft-quiesce (announce with lowered priority) rather than hard withdraw for canary to let traffic bleed off. See attached traffic-drain-diagram.png for suggested drain sequence.

Two open items I need resolved before I can be primary incident lead:
1) A documented rehearse window (we should rehearse the evict-restore path in a staging environment this week).
2) Confirmed on-call phone list and escalation chain (ops-team @ Acme can you share).

I'll be available Sat morning for a last-minute sync.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Private Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MOP sync — weekend MOP window and retrograde rollback plan

Thanks — a few technical clarifications from the runtime side: 

- KV snapshot approach: agreed. We'll add a preflight check that verifies snapshot integrity (sha256) and a TTL sanity check on keys > 24h before action. I updated the MOP with the check command and exit codes.
- Retrograde downgrade path: important note — when downgrading binaries we must also ensure the model-compatibility metadata is compatible or we will force-miss cache entries. My proposed safe sequence (added to MOP): stop tokenizers last, restart runtime with compatibility flags, then rehydrate KV cache. That avoids corrupted KV entries referencing newer tokenization IDs.
- Canary gating: will run 3 successive synthetic prompts (from the smoke harness) and require <0.5% semantic drift across the sample set before progressing. If we see unnatural responses we'll abort and trigger rollback.

I'll schedule a 90-minute rehearsal slot in staging tomorrow (Mon 2027-05-31 14:00 PT) — please add attendees. I also opened JIRA SUP-3421 to track the compatibility check automation. Drive runbook updated: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMOP-Runbooks (see file: retro-downgrade-checklist.md).

-Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Miguel Santos <ops.lead@acmehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-team@acmehealth.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MOP sync — weekend MOP window and retrograde rollback plan

Thanks Jonas / team — AcmeHealth ops confirms the Sat 06/05 02:00-05:00 PT window. A few notes from our side: 

- We will supply the on-call rotation and primary contact phone numbers by Tue 2027-05-31 COB.
- Change request form attached (change_request_form.pdf) — please fill the risk section and return.
- For the retrograde rollback: we prefer the soft-quiesce approach (as Neha suggested) and ask that the canary not be hard-withdrawn until we've had at least one successful fleet smoke. This reduces impact on our upstream load balancers.

We'll keep a bridge open during the window; please send an invite to the shared bridge (ops-acme-bridge@acmehealth.com) once scheduled.

Best,
Miguel Santos
Lead SRE, AcmeHealth
